reconfigure_add_field.description: Fields added so far: {count}. Enter a name (e.g. "Systolic Pressure") - the key used in automations is generated from it automatically (e.g. `systolic_pressure`), or you can set your own.

data.label: Name
data.key: Key (optional - auto-generated from the name if left blank)

edit_field_label.title: Edit field label
edit_field_label.description: The field's key ({key}) - used in automations - is not affected by this.

edit_select_options.title: Edit options
edit_select_options.description: Current options for "{key}": {options}. Edit the full list to add, remove, rename, or reorder options. Existing records keep their stored value, so a removed or renamed value is preserved as-is on old records even though it is no longer accepted for new ones.

set_retention.title: Retention for {name}
set_retention.description: Records are kept forever by default. Optionally set a retention period, a maximum record count, or the threshold at which a warning is raised.

export_data.title: Export data
export_data.description: Download this record type's records as a CSV file.

import_data.title: Import data
import_data.description: Upload a CSV file to import records into this record type. Rows whose ID already exists are skipped, not overwritten - as are rows with no ID that exactly match an existing record's timestamp and data.

error.already_exists: A record type with this name already exists.
error.invalid_key: Use lowercase letters, numbers, and single underscores only.
error.reserved_key: This key is reserved and cannot be used.
error.duplicate_key: This key is already used by this record type.
error.required_not_allowed_on_existing_type: A required field can only be added while creating a new record type.
error.duplicate_option: Options must be unique - remove the duplicate values.
error.confirmation_required: You must confirm you understand the risk before proceeding.
error.file_not_found: The uploaded file could not be read - please try uploading it again.
error.database_error: The database schema could not be updated. Check Home Assistant logs and Repairs before trying again.

record_count_high.title: Record count is high for {name}
record_count_high.description: The record type "{name}" has {count} stored records. Consider configuring a retention period or a maximum record count for this record type from its card on the integration's page.

database_schema_error.title: Custom Records database needs attention
database_schema_error.description: Custom Records stopped loading to protect stored data because its database structure is missing or does not match the configured record types: {error}. Restore a known-good backup or inspect the Home Assistant logs before making further changes.
